hook: Adhesion proteins BOC and CDON help Sonic Hedgehog cells grow long signaling protrusions
hook_turn: help Sonic Hedgehog cells grow long signaling protrusions
summary: The proteins BOC and CDON recruit the actin regulators FARP1 and Cdc42 to extend cytonemes, thin cell projections that carry Sonic Hedgehog signals. Losing them shortened cytonemes in cultured cells, and losing CDON reduced cytonemes in mouse spinal cord and shifted neuron fate. How much cytonemes matter for signaling in living tissue beyond this system remains to be shown.
title: Cell adhesion molecule-related proteins signal to promote cytoneme elongation from Sonic Hedgehog-producing cells.
